title: Where is Spark running?
prompt: Before a support call, the platform team prints a short summary of the session. What does this program print? Type each line on its own line.
program:
sc = spark.sparkContext
print(f"Spark {spark.version} on {sc.master}")
print(sc.defaultParallelism * 2, "tasks in two rounds")
print(spark.conf.get("spark.sql.session.timeZone"))
hints: `spark.version` is the Spark version this environment runs, and `master` says where it runs, cores included.
`defaultParallelism` is how many tasks run side by side; here it matches the number of cores.
Times in this environment are shown in one time zone, the one with no offset.
explanation: This environment runs Spark 4.0.1 in local mode with 2 cores, so `master` is `local[2]` and `defaultParallelism` is 2; two rounds of 2 tasks is 4. The session time zone is `UTC`.
